notes: The complete original catalog, source lock and original source material are retained. The archive commit, rather than a potentially stale upstream version string, identifies this resource.
Generate into a fresh directory and retain the seed, generator identity, options, compiler flags and output. Seed reproducibility is qualified for the selected binary on this declared platform.
Package checks compare the same GCC compiler at O0 and O2. This is useful differential agreement, not an independent reference compiler or a proof that every random program is correct.
Native source and binary profiles are exercised on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64; no OCI, other ABI/OS, full compiler campaign or official benchmark score is claimed.
CMake/Ninja/M4 are build-only dependencies. Exact private tool bindings are supported by the maintainer replay without modifying APT/dpkg.
Assertions are enabled. All upstream source files remain unmodified in share/csmith/source; the build uses an independent copy.

The checked CMake version-discovery expression in the build copy is replaced with the exact locked short commit 0cdc710, preventing an enclosing checkout from becoming the reported generator identity.

Both installed static and shared volatile-runtime libraries are exercised; the original distributed scripts are preserved as material and may require their own external compiler/reducer configuration.
C++ consumers must use C++17 or a compiler mode accepting standard hexadecimal floating-point literals in the installed safe-math header.

A checked build-copy patch adds the two int64_t/uint64_t volatile-runtime definitions already declared in the pinned header, using its existing upstream DEFINE_VOLATILE_FUNCTIONS macro. Both libraries are exercised across all eight integer types. The exact original runtime source stays untouched in share/csmith/source.
